about: Which TestNG groups -- and so which suites -- an automated case belongs to. Read by tools/agent/suitemap.py. Every case gets the groups in `always`; a rule adds its group when the case's type AND priority are among those listed (a missing list matches anything). A person can set a case's groups by hand on the review table; that wins. Each group runs as src/test/resources/suites/jira/group-<group>.xml.
